text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Wuppertal stood at 9.0 €/m², up 4.2 % year‑on‑year and 27.2 % over the past five years. The 25th‑percentile is 8.0 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 10.0 €/m², placing the city 33rd of the 37 most expensive German markets.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 2.3 % and an average of 35 days on market; 17 % of listings are let within a week. Rent for a 60 m² unit is 540 €/month, representing a rent‑burden of 12.8 % for two residents, while asking rents sit 48 % above the 2022 census existing rent of 6.1 €/m².

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 9.47 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 9.22 €/m² and 9.67 €/m², implying a 5.2 % increase.
